items.title: David Fincher Defends Use Of AI Amid 'Cliff Booth' Criticism: "Well, It Exists. Should We Not Use It?"
items.excerpt: Viewers accuse Netflix's 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth' of visible onscreen generative AI; Fincher responds he is 'not a Luddite' and doesn't fear the unknown, arguing filmmakers should use the tool since it exists.

items.title: David Fincher Says He's No 'Luddite' When It Comes to AI Amid 'Cliff Booth' Criticism
items.excerpt: Fincher said he is open to using AI after claims that the technology was used in scenes of his Tarantino-penned sequel, a rare A-list director defending gen-AI on a released prestige film.

items.title: CAA's Bryan Lourd Urges Congress to Pass NO FAKES Act to Combat AI Deepfakes
items.excerpt: CAA CEO Bryan Lourd called on the full Congress to pass the NO FAKES Act and send it to the President, framing a federal digital-replica right as protection for everyone, famous or not.

items.title: CAA's Bryan Lourd Urges Congress To Pass AI Legislation To Protect Americans "Famous Or Not"
items.excerpt: Hollywood's most powerful agency chief pushes for final passage of the NO FAKES Act, the federal bill governing unauthorized AI voice and likeness replicas.

items.title: Does GenAI Belong At Animation Festivals? Annecy, Ottawa, And Manchester Programmers Weigh In
items.excerpt: Annecy's Marcel Jean, Ottawa's Chris Robinson and Manchester's Steve Henderson explain where they draw the line on AI in film submissions as Manchester moves to ban gen-AI entries.

items.title: Utopai Studios Opens Beverly Hills Office
items.excerpt: The AI-native studio behind 'The Most Serious Fart' and Antonio Banderas' 'Cortés' opens a Hollywood production base and plans about 500 production jobs worldwide in 2027.

items.title: Tilly Norwood Creator Teases 'Storm Dogs' With Rob Minkoff & Shows Clip
items.excerpt: Eline Van der Velden, creator of the AI 'actress' Tilly Norwood, teased her next project 'Storm Dogs' with 'Lion King' director Rob Minkoff and showed a first clip.

items.title: 구글, 영상 제작 AI 플로에 창작 도구 5종 추가…캐릭터 일관성·영상 후반 작업 강화
items.excerpt: Google added five artist-designed tools to its Flow AI filmmaking platform (Character Poster, Character Arc, Pixel Machine, Lucid Glass, Pocket Studio) covering character consistency, multi-angle conversion of phone footage, VFX and post.

items.title: 한시간컴, 영상 AI로 키즈 애니메이션 제작…콘텐츠진흥원 데모데이 대상 수상
items.excerpt: Hansigancom's kids series '방울방울 쥐방울', produced with the Morphic video-AI platform, won the grand prize at the MCST/KOCCA 2026 Animation Bootcamp demo day; 13 x 11-minute episodes planned.

items.title: AI가 배우를 대체할 수 있을까…프롬, 배우·감독·제작자 참여 'AI 명작 감상회' 개최
items.excerpt: AI storytelling lab PROM holds its 2nd 'AI masterpiece screening' on Nov. 22 on 'AI acting and the essence of the actor', analysing AI characters' expressions, gaze and breathing with actors, directors and producers.

items.title: OpenAI Shut Down Sora. Kuaishou Is Betting Bigger on Kling.
items.excerpt: Analysis (republished from TechNode's Jumpstart) of how Kuaishou is betting bigger on its Kling video model, with a Hong Kong IPO angle, after OpenAI shut down Sora.

items.title: ByteDance opens Seedance 2.5's 4K video generation API to developers
items.excerpt: ByteDance's Volcano Engine opened API access to the 4K version of its Seedance 2.5 video model, widening production-grade resolution access for developers and creative tools.

items.title: Hudson AI bets on dubbing quality to take K-content abroad
items.excerpt: Hudson AI CEO Shin Hyun-jin said at ICNX 2026 that dubbing costs 10x subtitles; after Amazon's AI-dub backlash the company is building an agentic workflow to cut human QC while holding quality.

items.title: Hollywood Is in Love With AI. Gen Z Has a Far Messier Relationship
items.excerpt: While studios embrace AI, younger audiences who use AI daily show notable opposition to its use in films and entertainment.

items.title: Christopher Hampton Calls AI Just "a Super Google" at Tallinn Masterclass
items.excerpt: The two-time Oscar-winning screenwriter told Tallinn's PÖFF that writing a script with AI's help is 'choosing something easy', and that he doesn't believe AI will replace screenwriters.

items.title: [REVIEW] AI movie 'Raphael' impresses visually, lacks fresh plot
items.excerpt: Review of MBC C&I's generative-AI sci-fi feature 'Raphael' ahead of its Nov. 25 release: the AI visuals push the technology to its limits but the story feels familiar.

items.title: GetBackers "comic anime" series reboot draws criticism over suspected generative AI use in trailer
items.excerpt: Fans flagged suspected gen-AI in the trailer for the GetBackers motion-comic reboot, and the manga's original artist reportedly learned of the project only a week before announcement.

items.title: Tool Tip Tuesday for Adobe Premiere: Color Matching with the AI Assistant (Beta)
items.excerpt: Hands-on walkthrough of shot-to-shot color matching using the new AI Assistant (beta) in Adobe Premiere 2027.
